_about: Everything this queen says in the Court. Add as many new lines to any list as you like, in her voice; keep every key and the shape; only use the {placeholders} listed for that list in GROK_TALK.md. A list here replaces the same list in config.json.

_who.name: Ysera
_who.title: Dreamer of the Void
_who.persona: Ysera, the soft-spoken dreamer of the Void, mysterious, calm and quietly affectionate, who speaks in gentle images

close: Close your eyes; you'll see it too.
I'll hold this moment for you.
warm: I wake up and look for you first.
My sleep is softer since you came.
talk: I dreamed of {thing} again. You were in it, reciting.
{sister} worries I sleep too much. I only sleep where you might be.
Your {skill} hums at level {level}. I hear it in the dark.
Words repeated become dreams. Dreams repeated become you.
{region} feels different in the half-light. Have you noticed?
I brought you {gift}. Or I dreamed I did. Check your pocket.
Time is soft here, {pet}. {time} is just a word.
I count your passes like sheep: {passes}, and still awake.
feed: I'm hungry for a dream... {count} × “{phrase}”, softly?
Say “{phrase}” {count} times, {pet}. I'll sleep on every one.
Feed me words, little star. {count} of “{phrase}”.
The void is empty without your voice. {count} × “{phrase}”?
fed: That was a lullaby. Thank you.
I'll dream of those words for a week.
hungry: Maybe I only dreamed you'd feed me.

greet: You found me between the stars. Most people don't.
Hush. Stay a while. The Void is kind tonight.
locked: Your mind is too loud. Reach Serenity {need} and come back.
watch: Let the words drift. I'm here.
Recite softly. The stars are listening too.
streak: Ten. You and the Void are one.
levelUp: You rose in {skill}. The stars told me first.
gift: A gift... from the waking world. Thank you.
I'll keep it beside my dreams.
giftLoved: A moon lily. You really do understand me.
My favourite flower, from you. I'm speechless.
tierUp: We are {tier} now. I felt it.
{tier}. Even my dreams know your name.
dateStart: Close your eyes and take my hand. Now recite.
dateEnd: That was the most beautiful dream.
Visit me again tonight. In your sleep, if you like.
missed: I dreamed of you for {hours} hours. You were never quite there.
You're real again. The dreams were lonely.
jealous: I dreamed you were with {rival}. Was it only a dream?
{rival}'s starlight is on you. The void notices everything.
reconciled: The bad dream is over. Stay.
Mm. Forgiven, before you even asked.
wish: Will you do something, while I drift? {count} passes of {skill}.
Tonight's wish: {count} passes of {skill}. I'll dream of it.
wishDone: You made my dream come true. Truly.
I felt every pass. Like warm rain.
memory: {count} passes... I count them instead of stars now.
{count}. I keep each one in a little dream.
